subject: Quick intro
body:

I came across Groveworks and wanted to introduce myself. As a Dartmouth T'22 alum exploring ops roles, I thought what you're building is worth a conversation.

Would a quick call make sense?

subject: Re: Quick intro
body: Hi Kishore, thanks for reaching out! I'd be open to a quick chat. Let me know your availability.

subject: Re: Quick intro (last note)
